Cast NiAl-Cr(Mo)-W/Nb

The NiAl-28Cr-5Mo-0.5W-0.5Nb (at%, denoted as NiAl-Cr(Mo)-W/Nb) alloy was prepared by induction melting in vacuum from starting materials of 99.9% Ni, 99.9% Al, 99.5%Cr, 99.5% Mo, 99.0%W and 99.0% Nb, the cast rod is 36mm in diameter.

The directional solidification was performed in vacuum at a pulling rate of 5mm/min, using a modified Bridgman method with the temperature gradient of 70-80K/cm through the solid and liquid interface. The ingot is 16mm in diameter and 150mm in length.

evidence.section: Microstructure of the DS NiAl-Cr(Mo)-W/Nb alloy
evidence.quote: the transverse microstructure of the DS NiAl-Cr(Mo)-W/Nb alloy, which is typically eutectic colonies of NiAl and Cr(Mo) phase. The eutectic colony is chrysanthemum-like, and the size is about 100-200 µm.

evidence.section: Microstructure of the DS NiAl-Cr(Mo)-W/Nb alloy
evidence.quote: Fig.1(b) is the longtitudinal microstructure of the DS alloy, which is lamellar, i.e. the lamellar Cr(Mo) phases (grey white) distribute along the direction of the directional solidification

evidence.section: Microstructure of the DS NiAl-Cr(Mo)-W/Nb alloy
evidence.quote: The white phases which was indicated “1” in Fig.1(a) and “2” in Fig.1(b) segerate non-continuously in the cell boundary. The EDS result of the white phase indicated “1” in Fig.1(a) is as follow(at.%): Al8.40, Cr36.58, Ni21.8, Nb24.79, Mo7.25, W1.18.
